scope: Twenty main E10/P0 task episodes: SmolVLA and pi05, lockstep/realtime, initial states1..5; no GPU, no rerun, no training

aggregation_definitions.model_call_ms: Per-episode mean of metadata.model_inference_ms from all completed non-bootstrap chunks, including late-drained chunks, then equal-weight mean over five episodes. Timer starts after raw input construction and saved preprocessing; spans policy.predict_action_chunk, saved output postprocessing, and final CUDA synchronization, excluding subsequent NumPy conversion. Policy-internal image preparation remains included. Not GPU-kernel-only time, and narrower than the separate profile full native predict call.
aggregation_definitions.worker_with_ros_ms: Same chunk set and episode-weighting; finished_time - started_time spans sensor ROS, model call and action ROS. Parent IPC/poll is excluded. Do not label difference as DDS-only latency.
aggregation_definitions.action_source_age_ms: For executed non-held, non-bootstrap actions only, observation capture to action application; average within episode, then equal-weight mean over five. Not merely inference latency.
aggregation_definitions.pooled_hold_fraction: Sum hold ticks / sum all ticks across five episodes, not mean episode fraction. Lockstep zero means model waits freeze simulator and are not counted as hold ticks.
aggregation_definitions.effective_control_hz: Reciprocal of per-episode mean observed non-null tick_interval_s; then mean across five episodes. Configured20Hz is separate.
aggregation_definitions.median_final_goal_xy_mm: Median of five terminal bowl-to-plate XY distances; official task predicate is primary success, XY alone is not task completion.
aggregation_definitions.memory: Model-process Torch peak allocated bytes, converted using2**30; not total GPU memory and no host RAM maximum recorded.

initial_pairing.interpretation: Same raw input across models within a mode. Across lockstep/realtime physics is matched, but cached synchronous camera versus regenerated clone camera has different observation phase; not a pure latency intervention.

limits: One known LIBERO Spatial task with five fixed initial states; ten episodes per model do not establish suite-level quality or statistical superiority.
SmolVLA main experiment was performed first; pi05 was a subsequent frozen-model addition using the same recorded protocol. Hardware scheduling/thermal/software timing may differ across sessions.

Lockstep allows up to280 control steps (14 simulated seconds) and pauses physical progress during inference/rendering. Realtime runs for at most14 actual seconds or280 ticks. Lockstep success is not success within14 actual seconds.
Both models generate50 native actions with10 flow steps; main scheduler executes at most10 from each chunk and requests only after queue exhaustion.
Same seed does not ensure identical asynchronous trajectories: camera/inference completion crossing one control period changes inputs and chunk switch position.
Both models succeed5/5 under lockstep; only the measured realtime success count differs3/5 versus5/5. Do not claim pi05 superior under every metric or all tasks.

A lower worker time accompanies less waiting and more realtime task completion but does not isolate a causal effect of model latency from policy architecture, task adaptation, trajectory and sensor scheduling.

Task model_inference_ms excludes raw input construction/saved preprocessing, whereas fixed-observation profiling wall_ms covers the whole native predict request. Different timing boundaries also contribute to their different numeric values.
